en.title: INSPIRE Leadership Academy 2025
en.desc: INSPIRE Leadership Academy 2025: three schools in Chisinau, Comrat and Tiraspol empowering young leaders to drive regional and global change.
about:
The INSPIRE Network (Inter-University Network for Sustainable Peace, Innovation, Research, and Education) is a collaborative initiative launched in the Republic of Moldova, bringing together universities and NGOs.

In 2025 the INSPIRE Academy of Future Leaders hosts three specialised schools, each designed to equip young leaders with the knowledge and skills to address global challenges and drive change in their communities. Earlier experience: peace.education.md.

The network established Centers for Civic and Global Engagement within participating universities. They serve as local hubs for collaboration, offering resources and support for students and young researchers.

InspireEdu (Inspiring Education for Future Leaders) is a project funded by the Embassy of the Kingdom of the Netherlands in Moldova.
en.schoolsLead: Each school runs 9:00 AM – 9:00 PM: interactive workshops, case studies, group discussions and excursions with hands-on learning.

schools.title: Strategic Leadership and Sustainable Peace Development
schools.text: An intensive programme for current and aspiring young leaders: strategic leadership, sustainable development, environmental stewardship, social equity and economic viability.
areas: Sustainable Energy and the Green Agenda

schools.title: Tech Peacemakers: Digital Solutions for Social Cohesion
schools.text: Skills to harness technology for positive societal impact: AI, blockchain and data analytics, with attention to ethics, cybersecurity, responsible tech use and combating misinformation.
areas: Emerging Technologies and Leadership in Tech
Cybersecurity Awareness and Sustainability in Tech

schools.title: Future Voices: Media and Communication for Young Innovators
schools.text: Communication skills to convey ideas in a changing media landscape: storytelling, public speaking, digital literacy, ethical media practice and personal branding.

en.grant: As part of INSPIRE Academy 2025, implemented with the support of the Embassy of the Kingdom of the Netherlands in the Republic of Moldova, a mini-grant competition is planned for students of the three schools. ru.title: INSPIRE Leadership Academy 2025
ru.desc: INSPIRE Leadership Academy 2025: три школы в Кишинёве, Комрате и Тирасполе для молодых лидеров, которые меняют регион и мир.
about:
Сеть INSPIRE (Inter-University Network for Sustainable Peace, Innovation, Research, and Education — Межуниверситетская сеть за устойчивый мир, инновации, исследования и образование) — совместная инициатива, запущенная в Республике Молдова и объединяющая университеты и НКО.

В 2025 году Академия будущих лидеров INSPIRE проведёт три специализированные школы. Каждая даёт молодым лидерам знания и навыки, чтобы отвечать на глобальные вызовы и менять свои сообщества. Предыдущий опыт: peace.education.md.

Сеть создала Центры гражданской и глобальной вовлечённости при университетах-участниках. Они служат локальными центрами сотрудничества и предлагают ресурсы и поддержку студентам и молодым исследователям.

InspireEdu (Inspiring Education for Future Leaders) — проект, финансируемый Посольством Королевства Нидерландов в Молдове.
ru.schoolsLead: Каждая школа работает с 9:00 до 21:00: интерактивные воркшопы, разбор кейсов, групповые дискуссии и экскурсии с практическим обучением.

schools.title: Стратегическое лидерство и развитие устойчивого мира
schools.text: Интенсивная программа для действующих и будущих молодых лидеров: стратегическое лидерство, устойчивое развитие, бережное отношение к окружающей среде, социальное равенство и экономическая жизнеспособность.

schools.title: Tech Peacemakers: цифровые решения для социальной сплочённости
schools.text: Навыки применения технологий на общественную пользу: ИИ, блокчейн и аналитика данных, с вниманием к этике, кибербезопасности, ответственному использованию технологий и борьбе с дезинформацией.
areas: Новые технологии и лидерство в IT

ro.title: INSPIRE Leadership Academy 2025
ro.desc: INSPIRE Leadership Academy 2025: trei școli la Chișinău, Comrat și Tiraspol pentru tineri lideri care schimbă regiunea și lumea.
about:
Rețeaua INSPIRE (Inter-University Network for Sustainable Peace, Innovation, Research, and Education — Rețeaua interuniversitară pentru pace durabilă, inovare, cercetare și educație) este o inițiativă de colaborare lansată în Republica Moldova, care reunește universități și ONG-uri.

În 2025, Academia viitorilor lideri INSPIRE găzduiește trei școli specializate. Fiecare oferă tinerilor lideri cunoștințele și abilitățile necesare pentru a răspunde provocărilor globale și a aduce schimbare în comunitățile lor. Experiență anterioară: peace.education.md.

Rețeaua a înființat Centre pentru implicare civică și globală în universitățile participante. Acestea sunt hub-uri locale de colaborare, care oferă resurse și sprijin studenților și tinerilor cercetători.

InspireEdu (Inspiring Education for Future Leaders) este un proiect finanțat de Ambasada Regatului Țărilor de Jos în Moldova.
ro.schoolsLead: Fiecare școală se desfășoară între 9:00 și 21:00: ateliere interactive, studii de caz, discuții de grup și excursii cu învățare practică.

schools.title: Leadership strategic și dezvoltarea păcii durabile
schools.text: Un program intensiv pentru tineri lideri actuali și în devenire: leadership strategic, dezvoltare durabilă, protecția mediului, echitate socială și viabilitate economică.
areas: Instituții internaționale și strategii de dezvoltare

schools.title: Tech Peacemakers: soluții digitale pentru coeziune socială
schools.text: Abilități pentru a folosi tehnologia în beneficiul societății: AI, blockchain și analiza datelor, cu atenție la etică, securitate cibernetică, utilizarea responsabilă a tehnologiei și combaterea dezinformării.
areas: Tehnologii emergente și leadership în tech
Securitate cibernetică și durabilitate în tech
Competențe viitoare și dezvoltarea forței de muncă

schools.title: Future Voices: media și comunicare pentru tineri inovatori
schools.text: Abilități de comunicare pentru a transmite idei într-un peisaj media în schimbare: storytelling, vorbit în public, alfabetizare digitală, practici media etice și brand personal.

programmes:
This intensive program is designed to empower current and aspiring young leaders with the tools and knowledge necessary to drive sustainable change within their organizations and communities. Participants will explore key concepts of strategic leadership while focusing on sustainable development principles, including environmental stewardship, social equity, and economic viability.

Key Focus Areas: International Institutions and Development Strategies; SDGs and Sustainability Policy; Social Cohesion for Community Growth; Community Engagement Strategies; Leadership and Public Diplomacy; Development and Gender; Food Sustainability and Security; Sustainable Energy and the Green Agenda.

November 19-21, 2025
BUSINESS GAME PRACTICAL MARKETING
 Expert Sergey Tkachenko,  linkedin.com

This business game is designed specifically for young people and students who want to try their hand at marketing and management, gain real-world decision-making skills, and experience the dynamics of a real market. Participants become the heads of virtual companies: they analyze customer needs, study competitors, create their own products, set prices, develop advertising, and devise a promotion strategy. Every decision impacts sales, profits, and the company’s position in the simulation.

The game is based on a computerized marketing simulator that simulates real-world market processes and demonstrates how consumer behavior changes in response to your actions. This allows students to see how marketing tools work in practice and understand which decisions truly yield results. The format combines brief expert explanations with active teamwork: participants discuss ideas, test strategic approaches, respond to market changes, and analyze their results. The game helps develop critical thinking, creativity, teamwork skills, the ability to make quick decisions, and adapt to change. It’s a safe and engaging opportunity to try your hand at business and marketing, gaining experience that will be useful in real-world professional work.

9.30 – 13.00 KEEP COOL is a strategic team game for participants in groups, where each participant represents a group of countries (Europe, OPEC, developing countries, etc.). Over the course of 1-2 hours, players choose between «black» and «green» growth, confront climate risks (droughts, floods), and consider lobbying pressures from everything from the oil industry to environmental movements. The winner is the one who most effectively balances economic interests and climate responsibility. But if someone acts too aggressively and selfishly, everyone loses.
